name: BANKSY niches
author: PointillViz reference tools
description: Which niches the tissue divides into, judged by what each cell and its neighbours express.
long_description: Groups cells into niches by their own expression together with their neighbours', with the authors' BANKSY package. Paints the niches on the map, with their cell types, marker genes and a download of every cell's niche.
citation: Singhal V, Chou N, Lee J, et al. BANKSY unifies cell typing and tissue domain segmentation for scalable spatial omics data analysis. Nat Genet 56, 431-441 (2024).

params.name: lambda_param
params.label: Neighbourhood weight (lambda)
params.help:
Sets how much a cell's neighbourhood counts against its own expression.
The authors use 0.8 for tissue domains and 0.2 for spatially informed cell types; 0 ignores space.

params.name: k_geom
params.label: Spatial neighbours (k_geom)
params.help:
Sets how many nearest cells form each cell's neighbourhood.
The authors use 15 for single-cell data.

params.name: max_m
params.label: AGF order (max_m)
params.help:
Sets whether the azimuthal Gabor filter (AGF) is added: 1 adds it, 0 uses the neighbourhood's mean alone.
The AGF responds where expression changes across a neighbourhood, as at a border; the authors recommend it.

params.name: nbr_weight_decay
params.label: Neighbour weights
params.help: Sets how a neighbour's weight falls with its distance.

params.name: zscore_by
params.label: Z-score
params.help:
Sets over which cells each gene is z-scored when a run holds several sections. It changes nothing on one section.
Per section evens out differences in a gene's overall level between sections, which suits replicates of one tissue. Across all sections keeps them, which suits sections of different tissues.

params.name: pca_dims
params.label: Principal components (pca_dims)
params.help:
Sets how many principal components of the BANKSY matrix the clustering uses.
The authors use 20.

params.name: resolution
params.label: Leiden resolution
params.help:
Sets the resolution of the Leiden clustering: higher values give more, smaller niches, and lower values fewer, larger ones.
0.7 is the authors' default. Not used when Number of niches is set.

params.name: max_labels
params.label: Number of niches (max_labels)
params.help:
Sets a number of niches for the package to aim for, by searching for a resolution that gives it; 0 uses the resolution as set.
The search can stop short of that number, and the summary then says so.

params.name: num_nn
params.label: Expression neighbours (num_nn)
params.help:
Sets how many neighbours each cell has in the graph that Leiden partitions, in the space of the principal components.
The authors use 50.

params.name: n_top_genes
params.label: Variable genes (n_top_genes)
params.help:
Sets how many of the most variable genes are used.
The authors use 2000.

params.name: refine_iterations
params.label: Label refinement (iterations)
params.help:
Sets how many times each cell takes the niche of most of its 6 nearest cells; 0 is off.
The authors offer it for domain segmentation and warn that too much of it erodes fine domains.
